# The Seven Dwarfs

## Definition
The Seven Dwarfs are fictional characters from the fairy tale "Snow White," known for their small stature and distinct personalities. They serve as loyal protectors of Snow White, embodying themes of friendship and loyalty.

## Key Characteristics
- Each dwarf has a unique name and personality, often reflecting their traits (e.g., Doc, Grumpy, Happy).
- They live together in a cottage in the woods, symbolizing camaraderie and teamwork.
- The dwarfs are characterized by their dedication to Snow White, showcasing their protective nature.
- They play a crucial role in the narrative by defending Snow White from the evil Queen.

## Context
The Seven Dwarfs are integral to the story of "Snow White," a classic fairy tale that explores themes of good versus evil, innocence, and the importance of friendship. Their role highlights the significance of loyalty and support in overcoming adversity, making them memorable figures in popular culture and adaptations of the tale.
